operations.name: Saw Tube Blanks
operations.setup_note: Support the tube in contoured jaws without crushing it and saw individual blanks with allowance for facing both ends. The tube exceeds lathe bar capacity and will be chuck-loaded individually.

operations.name: Pre-Anneal Deburr and Clean
operations.setup_note: Support each sawn ring on the bench, remove saw burrs, and degrease and dry all surfaces before furnace loading. Retain machining allowance on both ends and cylindrical surfaces.

operations.name: Subcritical Stress-Relief Anneal
operations.setup_note: Batch all 10 blanks in one furnace load, individually supported and spaced to limit ring distortion. Hold at 1250°F (approximately 677°C) for at least two hours after the parts reach temperature, with atmosphere and cooling controlled to the approved PS-135.6 procedure.

operations.name: Post-Anneal Surface Cleaning
operations.setup_note: Support the cooled rings without distortion and manually remove any light oxide before washing and drying. Preserve the cylindrical and face machining allowances.

operations.name: Post-Anneal Verification
operations.setup_note: Check the stress-relief certificate and inspect cooled blanks for distortion and remaining machining allowance. Record a suitable soft-steel hardness reading without imposing an unsupported HRC acceptance limit.

operations.name: CNC Turn — First End and Through Bore
operations.setup_note: Grip the rear OD in relieved, full-contact soft jaws at low pressure, with an axial stop clear of the through-bore tool path. Face the first end, rough the exposed OD and bore, then finish the through bore before finishing the exposed OD and first-end R1 blend.

operations.name: CNC Turn — Second End
operations.setup_note: Reverse into bored, full-contact soft jaws gripping the finished front OD, locating against the first machined face and protecting its R1 edge. Face to final overall length, then rough and finish the former gripping land with the second-end R1 blend, matching the previously finished OD.

operations.name: Final Edge Break and Clean
operations.setup_note: Support the finished ring on a non-marring surface and break remaining sharp edges to 0.5 mm maximum without altering the specified R1 edges. Remove chips and coolant, then dry before inspection.

operations.name: Final Dimensional Inspection
operations.setup_note: Inspect all 10 rings in the unclamped, thermally stabilized condition for OD, ID, overall length, both R1 edges, and remaining edge breaks. Check diameters at multiple angular positions to detect clamping distortion and review material and stress-relief records.

clarifications.question: Can you provide the applicable revision of process specification PS-135.6?
clarifications.suggested_default: Provisionally stress-relieve the sawn blanks before final machining using the explicit 1250°F minimum-two-hour requirement; obtain approval of atmosphere, cooling, process order, and acceptance requirements before production.

clarifications.question: What is the complete current material callout beyond the cropped text ending in 'ERW D'?
clarifications.suggested_default: Provisionally use certified annealed SAE 1010–1026 seamless steel tubing, subject to confirmation that this supply condition is permitted.

clarifications.question: Is tubing with the provisional 144.8 mm OD and 134.5 mm ID available in the approved material condition?
clarifications.suggested_default: Obtain a supplier quotation against these provisional dimensions before purchasing; revise the stock selection and roughing allowance if a different commercial size is required.

assumptions.text: Metric values are treated as controlling, including the 0.5 maximum general edge break. No DIN ISO 13715 requirement is imposed because the drawing notes do not establish that standard.

The stated tube blank takes precedence over the optional rolled-and-welded construction. Bought seamless tube is provisionally selected; sheet forming, welding, forging, and casting sequences are not required.

Tube dimensions are provisional procurement targets, not asserted standard commercial sizes. The 20.875 mm blank provides 5 mm total facing allowance; machining_allowance_mm denotes a nominal diametral allowance, with actual cylindrical margins defined by the selected OD and ID.

The specified treatment is subcritical stress relief, not hardening. It is provisionally applied to sawn blanks before final machining to minimize finishing setups and remove subsequent heat-treatment distortion from the finished geometry; the material remains medium-machinability throughout.

The hardening template's selective masking, austenitizing, transformation soak, quenching, quench straightening, and tempering steps are omitted because no hardening is specified. Furnace loading and the specified subcritical hold are included in the stress-relief operation; cleaning, hardness recording, and inspection are retained.

The template requirement for post-treatment grinding or honing applies to hardening and is not applicable to this non-hardening stress relief. Subsequent finish turning and boring are retained for the stated tolerances; no grinding or honing requirement is present.

Center drilling, pilot drilling, tailstock support, and a steady rest are omitted because this is a short through-bored ring. Grooving and threading are omitted because no such features exist; parting is omitted because individual blanks are saw-cut.
Rough OD and bore steps are light skin-removal passes rather than bulk roughing because the provisional tube is near net size. Finish boring precedes finish OD turning to reduce thin-ring distortion.

F03 represents the two R1 OD end blends, produced incidentally by the respective finish-turning profiles because their radius is no greater than 1.2 mm. Separate generic chamfer cuts are omitted; remaining sharp edges are covered by deburring.

The end faces are not separately identified in the routing view. Facing therefore targets F01 because its specified axial length is physically established by these cuts; no drawing datum letters are invented.
The supplied computed mass appears to represent a solid cylinder rather than the through-bored ring. Stock selection and handling are based on the stated envelope and bore geometry, not that mass.
